description: Details required by Condition 4 (submission of details - a) elevation 1:10 and section 1:5 drawings of rear window, internal four panelled doors and architrave, LGF Victorian sliding doors and the two external LGF cupboard doors; b) specifications and elevations of Victorian grilles for HVAC and kitchen extraction grille; c) elevation and section in 1:10 and specification of fire-place surround; d) design of ceiling rose in 1:10; e) sample of stone, to be inspected in situ for replacement steps in external LGF staircase; f) design of external LGF cupboards; specification and elevation in 1:10;  g) elevation and section 1:10 of timber banister at first floor; h)  elevation and section in 1:10 of banquette seat; i)section drawing with specifications of UFH timber flooring; j) elevations in 1:10 of wall panelling, and kitchen, bathroom and bedroom joinery) of Listed Building consent LB/25/05726 (Internal and external works including alterations and refurbishment works)
